notes: All surface features used here were recently added targeting this spell: on_caster_spends_action, OngoingEffect.attack_roll, caster_recasts_spell, emit_light. Clean encode with two caveats: (1) The 60-foot attack range of the hurled flame is not captured — OngoingEffect.attack_roll omits `attachment`, so the session resolves targeting range. (2) The cantrip scaling node (scale_die_count) is not emitted by the tracer for OngoingEffect.attack_roll hits — traceEffectAtomScaling is not called from that handler branch. Both are tracer/surface limitations noted in the Dhall comments, not blocking widenings.
